title: Submarines take evasive action from fast-closing underwater objects

tellings.quote: I've had several submarine officers come to me two uh and one listed and they all reported to me these instances where they were all of a sudden en encountering an object under a water that was closing rapidly

plain: US Navy submarine crews have suddenly come upon objects under the water closing in on them fast, and have had to take evasive action. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels he heard this from several submarine officers and one enlisted sailor, who each came to him with their own reports. If true, it would mean unknown objects are moving through the ocean faster than the boats meant to patrol it.
